candidates.statement: Postgres save_order spans show connection pool size 5 with 0 idle and DependencyUnavailable errors, causing order service 503s and gateway checkout 502s (p95 ~2406ms).
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or logs; pool exhaustion inferred from trace attributes only.

report.explanation: Traces show repeated postgres.save_order failures with pool size 5 and 0 idle, order 503s, and gateway checkout 502s at ~2s. Metrics confirm elevated checkout p95 and 502 rate. Pool exhaustion is the best-supported bounded cause; postgres-side metrics are missing.
